verdict.rationale: Segment has AI-powered features, so whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question, but the evidence never says it can. The 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor' doc links only send documentation to outside assistants. Functions and the Public API are developer building blocks, not an MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
